scripts.pm2:delete: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:PM2_HOME=(Resolve-Path .).Path + '\.pm2'; pm2 delete ecosystem.config.cjs --only covclasses"
scripts.pm2:persist: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:PM2_HOME=(Resolve-Path .).Path + '\.pm2'; if (-not (Test-Path $env:PM2_HOME)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $env:PM2_HOME | Out-Null }; pm2 startOrRestart ecosystem.config.cjs --only covclasses --update-env; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; pm2 save; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; pm2 startup"
scripts.pm2:restart: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:PM2_HOME=(Resolve-Path .).Path + '\.pm2'; pm2 restart ecosystem.config.cjs --only covclasses --update-env"
scripts.pm2:start: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:PM2_HOME=(Resolve-Path .).Path + '\.pm2'; if (-not (Test-Path $env:PM2_HOME)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $env:PM2_HOME | Out-Null }; pm2 startOrRestart ecosystem.config.cjs --only covclasses --update-env"
scripts.pm2:stop: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:PM2_HOME=(Resolve-Path .).Path + '\.pm2'; pm2 stop ecosystem.config.cjs --only covclasses"
